exposure: Separation of SARS-CoV-2 PCR-positive mother-newborn dyads
outcome: Use of expressed breast milk as hospital feeding source
cohort: Mother-newborn dyads where mothers were SARS-CoV-2 PCR-positive, recruited from 3 NYU Langone Health hospitals.
finding: Separation of mother-newborn dyads in the setting of COVID-19 leads to lower rates of breastfeeding both during hospitalization and at home following discharge compared with unseparated dyads.
